Get Beacon on all your devices
Point another device's camera here to open Beacon on it
Or copy the link and send it to another device (tap to copy):
To install on the device you're using right now:
iPhone / iPad (Safari or Chrome)
  1. Tap the Share icon (square with an arrow)
  2. Tap "Add to Home Screen"
Mac (Safari)
  1. File menu → "Add to Dock"
  2. It opens in its own window from then on
Mac / Windows (Chrome)
  1. Click the install icon in the address bar (or menu → "Cast, save, and share" → "Install page as app")
Before you use Beacon (in beta)

Beacon is not approved for operational use. Do not rely on it to plan or conduct a flight. Your released paperwork remains the record.

Do not upload real trip paperwork. No other operator's documents, and no passenger information. Use fabricated or sanitised documents for testing.

Beacon is an unfinished application in beta test. Features are incomplete, will change, and can break. Access is granted for evaluation only, on the terms below.
